name: paleoclimate
description: Paleoclimate research term and sample information extraction schema

fields.name: study_region
fields.description: Geographic region(s) where the study was conducted (e.g., North Atlantic, Tibetan Plateau, East African Rift).

fields.name: sample_type
fields.description: Type(s) of paleoclimate archive or sample material (e.g., stalagmite, sediment core, ice core, tree ring, coral).

fields.name: paleoclimate_proxy
fields.description: Proxy measurement(s) used to reconstruct past climate (e.g., oxygen isotopes, pollen, Mg/Ca, grain size).

fields.name: climate_variable
fields.description: Climate variable(s) reconstructed or analyzed (e.g., temperature, precipitation, monsoon intensity, sea level).

fields.name: time_period
fields.description: Geological time period(s) or age range(s) covered (e.g., Holocene, Last Glacial Maximum, Medieval Climate Anomaly).

fields.name: chronology_method
fields.description: Dating or chronology method(s) used (e.g., U-Th dating, radiocarbon, layer counting).

fields.name: reconstruction_method
fields.description: Statistical or modeling method(s) used for reconstruction (e.g., transfer function, Bayesian model, PCA).

fields.name: climate_forcing
fields.description: External forcing factor(s) discussed (e.g., orbital forcing, solar variability, volcanic activity, greenhouse gases).

fields.name: uncertainty_assessment
fields.description: Approaches used to quantify uncertainty (e.g., bootstrap, Monte Carlo, sensitivity test).

fields.name: data_availability
fields.description: Data availability statement or repository mentioned (e.g., NOAA WDS, PANGAEA, supplementary data).
examples: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information

fields.name: geographic_coordinates
fields.description: Latitude and longitude of sampling site(s) if explicitly stated.

fields.name: marine_terrestrial
fields.description: Whether the study focuses on marine, terrestrial, or cryospheric environments.

fields.name: keywords
fields.description: Additional domain-specific keywords not covered above.
